items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-01-27
items.q: I liked, listen, Armstrong playing, you know?

ctx.x: Well, I didn't have no preference but bands, you know what I mean?
You have a favorite musician there? I liked, listen, Armstrong playing, you know?

What was he like, you know, his playing, you know what I mean? A lot of people asked me why, you know what I mean, why I don't play that game. And you know what I mean? You know what I mean? Why don't you play that game? Yeah. You know what I mean? You know what I mean? I don't play that game. I said, well, no. I said, you're not supposed to play. You play your own style, you know? So I always liked his playing. Yeah. Always liked his playing.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1969-06-17
items.q: I liked Lister Armstrong playing before all the trumpet players.

ctx.x: Did you ever used to listen to any jazz records when you first had your band?

Did you ever listen to any jazz records? Yeah. Listen to what you call it, Lister Armstrong. See, Lister Armstrong left for me and went to Chicago, played with what you call it. In them days people even had radio. Like you had radio, people would come on, you see, you'd come on at a certain time of the evening, everybody would run to them people out and listen to that, you know what I mean? Like you wouldn't have no radio for a couple of, you know what I mean? You'd come on at a certain time in the evening, you…
Yeah. What are Lister Armstrong's records you mean?

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: I met him, but I never knowed him before, you know what I mean?

ctx.x: I met him, but I never knowed him before, you know what I mean? When did he? Until he came here. He came, you know, when he went off and came back to the play. He played over there in Old River. And I saw him twice.
